title: Any representative family generates its localizing closure
statement: Let C be a triangulated category with additive integer shifts. Let S be any property of objects, and let L = Loc(S) be the intersection of replete triangulated subcategories closed under existing coproducts and containing S, as in [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Suppose L has the inherited triangulation. Let E be an indexed family in L with an existing coproduct. If every object of S is isomorphic in C to some E_i, then E is a triangulated generating family of L [def-pc-generators]. Neither compactness, thickness, shift stability of S, nor pairwise nonisomorphism of representatives is required.

source.place: paragraph 2: the shifted left-orthogonal argument for generation of the localizing closure

proof.text: Suppose every map from the coproduct of the E_i to every shift of K in L is zero. Any map from E_i extends to the coproduct by assigning zero on the other summands. Hence every map from E_i to every shift of K vanishes. Representative isomorphisms and the canonical shift comparison of the inclusion L→C show that every map from an S-object to every ambient shift of K vanishes.

Let P be the shift closure of the singleton K. Its left orthogonal is replete and triangulated. It is closed under every existing coproduct: each map from the coproduct to an object of P is zero because all its injection components are zero. The vanishing just proved says that S lies in this left orthogonal.

Minimality of the localizing intersection places K in that left orthogonal. Since K itself lies in P, id_K is zero. Thus K is zero in C, hence also in the full subcategory L. Contrapositively each nonzero K has a nonzero map from the coproduct into some shift, which is the stated generating-family condition.

lean.statement:
theorem localizingClosure_generatingFamily
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C]
    (S : ObjectProperty C) [hL : (localizingClosure S).IsTriangulated]
    {I : Type*} (E : I → (localizingClosure S).FullSubcategory) [HasCoproduct E]
    (hE : ∀ X : C, S X → ∃ i : I, Nonempty (X ≅ (E i).obj)) :
    IsTriangulatedGeneratingFamily E
